# Gulf Shore Cooling

> Gulf Shore Cooling is a Fort Myers-based HVAC contractor providing air conditioning and heating services across Southwest Florida with emergency repair, maintenance memberships, and premium equipment partnerships.

Founded in 2000 by Gary and Lorraine Wright, Gulf Shore Cooling serves the Fort Myers area and surrounding Southwest Florida communities including Naples, Cape Coral, Port Charlotte, and Venice. The company specializes in AC repair, installation, maintenance, and emergency services with partnerships in Lennox and Bryant HVAC systems.

## Core Services

- [Air Conditioning Services](https://gulfshorecooling.com/air-conditioning): AC installation, repair, and maintenance services including ductless systems
- [Emergency HVAC Services](https://gulfshorecooling.com/emergency): 24-hour emergency HVAC repair services for Fort Myers area
- [Maintenance Memberships](https://gulfshorecooling.com/maintenance-memberships): VIP Maintenance Program and membership offerings for HVAC systems
- [Service Areas](https://gulfshorecooling.com/service-areas): Service areas in Southwest Florida including Alva, Bonita Springs, Cape Coral

## HVAC Products & Equipment

- [Lennox HVAC Products](https://gulfshorecooling.com/products/lennox-products): Lennox Premier Dealer offering energy-efficient cooling and smart thermostat
- [Bryant HVAC Products](https://gulfshorecooling.com/products/bryant-products): Bryant HVAC dealer offering Evolution System and related products
- [AC Max Drain Line Protection](https://gulfshorecooling.com/products/ac-max): AC Max drain line clog prevention product for condensate management
- [Kool Guard 2 Surge Protection](https://gulfshorecooling.com/products/kool-guard-2): Kool Guard 2 electrical surge protection system for AC units
